text: Off Broadway Nashville launched with 60 live music venues across Nashville, from listening rooms and honky tonks to jazz clubs and concert halls.
Added What to Expect write-ups to 20 venue pages.
Added What to Expect write-ups to 10 more venues (30 of 60).
Added What to Expect write-ups to 10 more venues (40 of 60).
Added What to Expect write-ups to 10 more venues (50 of 60).
Eastside Bowl is now listed under Madison, where it actually is, instead of East Nashville.
Every venue page now has a What to Expect write-up (60 of 60).
Every venue page now links to the venue's own website or social page.
Added new introductions and FAQs to the Concert Venues, Honky Tonks, Songwriter Rounds, Near the Opry, and East Nashville pages.
Each venue page now shows when it was last updated.

The Neighborhoods page now leads with the 8 areas that have the most live music. Venues in smaller areas like Germantown, Green Hills, and Madison are listed under "Smaller scenes" on the same page, and every venue can still be found with the filters on the Venues page.
